description:
Minimum Requirements: 
 At least 7-8 years of application development experience using Java.
 At least 2-5 years of Hybris experience, prefer majority of experience be in Hybris 5.
 Demonstrated B2B or B2C accelerator familiarity (preferably both)
 Familiarity with Java frameworks (Spring 3.x, JSF 2.x, ICEFaces 3.x, JUnit 4.x, Maven 3.x)
 Familiarity with the Eclipse IDE
 Experience with the Atlassian product suite
 Experience with the Agile development methodology including leading code reviews
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
   Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
 Code solutions to satisfy customer business needs
 Document key aspects of a project for the client and other team members
 Contribute to code reviews
 Provide input on estimates and planning
 We want you to learn the platform and will support you along the way.
 There will be opportunities to train on Hybris and complete certification.
   About You 
 We want someone who is passionate, flexible and able to communicate effectively.
 We want someone willing to learn and teach at the same time. We want independent thinkers who thrive with autonomy. We want you to have the confidence to make decisions and implement them. You should have the following skills:
 Competent with: 
 Spring Framework, particularly Spring MVC
 Object-oriented design patterns
 UNIX / Linux Concepts and Shells like BASH
 Front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSP
 eCommerce topics
 Git version control system
 SQL queries or ORM's.
 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 12+ months 
 
 VISA COPY MANDATORY
